title: How Well Do LLMs Represent Values Across Cultures? Empirical Analysis of LLM Responses Based on Hofstede Cultural Dimensions
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating LLMs using Hofstede's cultural dimensions (sociological constructs like Individualism vs. Collectivism and Power Distance). While the test prompts involve value-based decisions, the study benchmarks cultural alignment and sociological patterns rather than religion, theology, or formal moral/ethical frameworks.
